weekly_recap.previous_weekend: Week 13's nail-biter saw Greg Wigton scrape by Daniel Bahamonde 94.64 to 87.46, a 7.18-point margin that flatters Bahamonde more than he deserves. This rivalry's now dead even at 3-3, but don't expect Daniel to enjoy the symmetry — dude's sitting at zero career playoff appearances and a putrid .366 win percentage across three seasons, and this loss reads like a highlight reel of why. Jakobi Meyers popped off for 18.3 points, but Daniel benched Terry McLaurin's 19.1 points in favor of Rome Odunze's pathetic 1.8, a swap that literally would've won him the game. Meanwhile Greg's Davante Adams torched everyone for 19.8, and his Jets D/ST's putrid 3.0 points didn't even matter. Greg's now 93.9% locked for playoffs — same as last week. Daniel's stuck at 0%.
weekly_recap.game_of_the_week: The Invisible Hand (2nd) rolls into this one at 10-3, sitting pretty at 93.9 points... sorry, 93.9 pct playoff odds, unchanged from last week because there was never any doubt. Jay Nelson's High Quality H2O (3rd, also 10-3) is scrapping for tiebreaker positioning at 73.9 pct, also flat week over week, proving neither of these guys is losing sleep. Greg's torched Jay for a 3-1 all-time lead, and with Greg dropping 1584.72 points on the year to Jay's 1490.64, the numbers say this rivalry is currently a monologue. Jay's tougher schedule (0.1818) is his only excuse walking in. Someone finally beats someone with a real record on the line — enjoy the illusion of parity.
